sources: book.wvstateparks.com suppliers 11067393 'Cabwaylingo State Forest Electric Campsites' and 7988855 'Cabwaylingo State Forest Non-electric Campsites' (Ecomm SupplierTile, stays 2026-10-27 to 2027-06-20, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Booking site, one night, Oct 2026 and Apr-Jun 2027, weeknights and a Friday-Saturday stay alike: Spruce Creek's six 30-amp electric/water sites $39.99, the only sites tagged with an RV length class ('20-30 ft RV'). The 13 non-electric sites (Tick Ridge $19.99, one at $34.99; Spruce Creek $27.99) carry no RV tag and neither page says they take RVs, so they are left out of the base.

fees.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067393 (Spruce Creek Electric, $39.99 on 2026-10-27, 2027-04-20, 2027-06-15, 2027-06-18/20; tags 30 Amp, Water, 20-30 ft RV, 3 Pull Thru) + supplier 7988855 (Tick Ridge $19.99/$34.99, Spruce Creek $27.99, no RV tags), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067393 (all six Spruce Creek electric sites tagged 30 Amp and Water, none Sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two campgrounds with 21 sites plus a group camp: Spruce Creek (six electric/water sites, three tagged pull-through, RV class 20-30 ft; five non-electric) and Tick Ridge (eight non-electric).

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/cabwaylingo-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-cabwaylingo-state-forest/ ('two campgrounds with twenty-one sites combined and a group camp') + booking site unit names and tags, read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Convenient dumping station located nearby'; playground; Crum-Morgan picnic shelter.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/cabwaylingo-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-cabwaylingo-state-forest/ ('Campground store stocked with camping essentials, souvenirs, and firewood'; 'Convenient dumping station located nearby'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'The campgrounds are open spring through fall, weather permitting.' No dates given; the booking site still sold sites for late October 2026.

'Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office.' Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night Sunday-Thursday: the booking site sold one-night Tuesdays (Oct 2026, Apr and Jun 2027) and refused a one-night Friday in June 2027, though it sold one for Friday Oct 30 2026, nine days out.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/cabwaylingo-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-cabwaylingo-state-forest/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one night Sunday through Thursday'; 'There is a 14-night maximum stay') + booking site suppliers 11067393/7988855 (one night 2026-10-27 sold, 2026-10-30 sold, 2027-06-15 sold, 2027-06-18 none), read 2026-10-21

summary: Fees 19.99-34.99 (+$20 electric) -> 39.99 (the base is now the electric sites, the only ones tagged for RVs; non-electric prices in the note) and the entry's electric surcharge cleared; added hookups 30A/water, 21 sites with pull-throughs, camp store, spring-fall season; booking row confirmed (2-night weekend minimum, 14 max).
flags: Judgement call on the base rate: the 13 non-electric sites ($19.99-34.99) carry no RV-length tag on the booking site and the forest's page doesn't say whether RVs fit them; if a person confirms they take a 23-ft rig, the base drops back to $19.99.
